:::{#thm-rd-switch-ref}

#### Switching the reference group in a risk difference

For probabilities $\pi_1$ and $\pi_2$,
the [risk difference](#def-RD) with the reference group switched is the negative of the original:

$$\delta(\pi_2,\pi_1) = -\delta(\pi_1, \pi_2)$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-change-ref-group.

:::
